requestBody.query: What are eSIM and Dual SIM in Bell Mobility?

200.answer: An eSIM is a digital SIM built into some mobile devices, which allows you to activate a plan without a physical SIM. A Dual SIM device can use two SIMs, which can be a mix of physical SIM cards and/or eSIMs, so you can have two numbers on one phone.

snippets.text: Go to Mobility support What are eSIM and Dual SIM? What are eSIM and Dual SIM? An eSIM (short for embedded SIM) is a digital SIM that's built into certain mobile devices. It lets you activate a plan with a phone number without needing a physical SIM card. A Dual SIM device is able to use two SIMs instead of one. Depending on the device, this can be a combination of physical SIM card(s) and/or eSIM(s). With a Dual SIM smartphone, you can have two phone numbers on a single smartphone for calling and texting (SMS and MMS). For example, you can have separate personal and business numbers. The two phone numbers can be on the same account, or on different accounts. An eSIM-only device can only be activated on eSIM. There is no slot on the device for a physical SIM card.

requestBody.query: How to activate a line with an eSIM Bell Mobility?

200.answer:
To activate a line with an eSIM for Bell Mobility:
- New customers can activate online, in the MyBell app, or at a Bell store.
- Existing customers can log in to MyBell and select eSIM when adding a new line.
- You can also transfer your Bell Mobility service from a physical SIM to an eSIM by logging into MyBell or contacting support.
